explication: Phone Harness lets an agent operate a physical iPhone through macOS iPhone Mirroring or an Android device over adb, with an optional rented cloud Android. The main workflow is a script sent to the CLI, which exposes helpers that dispatch platform-neutral operations to a backend; the backend captures the screen and sends input, then returns text or other results. Cloud session management and device configuration are separate supporting flows. Some source excerpts are partial, so the graph includes only documented or directly supported wiring.
